description: Cape item mappings for AC Brotherhood SAV files (inside the LZSS-compressed inventory frame)
location: One of the LZSS frames following Block 2 holds the inventory. The frame index varies with game progression (frame #3 on a fresh save, #9-#15 on played saves) and a save may carry the records in more than one frame, so the frame must be located by decompressing and searching for the records. Verified identical on PC and PS3.

capes.name: Venetian Cape
capes.notes: Facebook-exclusive cape, unlockable by setting ownership flag to 0x01

capes.name: Medici Cape
capes.notes: Facebook-exclusive cape, unlockable by setting ownership flag to 0x01

unlock_method.description: Decompress each frame after Block 2, find the frame(s) containing both cape records (validate hash + zero run + 0x0B marker + cape id), set the byte at hash_offset+13 to 0x01 in every such frame, recompress, update the frame header's size and adler32, then rebuild the PS3 prefix CRC32 and re-encrypt if applicable
unlock_method.verified: In-game on PC, PS3 (US), and PS3 (EU) saves, July 2026
